scope: Original main application/launcher versus the production catalog-notification and final-cover-publication implementation, through the same actual indexed Library document and file-URI dispatch with --library lifetime. Both variants use the fixed qualified wrapper registration during primary AB/BA: the baseline selects original timestamp behavior; the candidate commits recent access without the immediate notification and transfers completion to its independent launcher worker, which restores native control before notification. The native-query helper, full scan, handler waiting, privilege transition and redraw are unchanged. Eight-second native stabilization, same boot, warm offline fixture, six predetermined AB/BA pairs.
